description: This file defines the Zend_Locale class, part of the Zend Framework, responsible for locale management including detection, translation, and configuration of locale settings.

classes.name: Zend_Locale
classes.description: Class for managing locale settings, detection, translation, and comparison within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Zend_Locale object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the locale.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Magic method to return string representation of the object.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Detects and returns the most probable locale based on various sources.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default locale for the application.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Detects the system's locale environment settings.

methods.name: getBrowser
methods.description: Returns the accepted languages from the HTTP headers.

methods.name: getFramework
methods.description: Returns the framework's set locale (stub implementation).

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the object.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language part of the locale.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region part of the locale if available.

methods.name: getHttpCharset
methods.description: Returns the accepted charset of the client.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another locale object is equal to this one.

methods.name: getTranslationList
methods.description: Returns a list of localized information based on the specified path.

methods.name: getLanguageTranslationList
methods.description: Returns a list of all languages translated to the given language.

methods.name: getScriptTranslationList
methods.description: Returns a list of all scripts translated to the given language.

methods.name: getCountryTranslationList
methods.description: Returns a list of all countries translated to the given language.

methods.name: getTerritoryTranslationList
methods.description: Returns a list of all territories translated to the given language.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Returns a localized information string for a given value.

methods.name: _getRegex
methods.description: Internal method to generate regex patterns from input strings or arrays.

methods.name: isLocale
methods.description: Checks if a locale identifier is valid or returns the normalized locale.

methods.name: getLocaleList
methods.description: Returns a list of all known locales, excluding internal ones.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets a cache for locale data.
